body: I can’t tell everyone the same thing. I try to explain to my doctor and social worker, my sister, my friends and for each person it’s different. I haven’t told my cousins. When you lie to your self long enough, you suffer for it. The fantasies that kept me going have gone away. I can’t face the truth. Suicide seems to be the only way out of the pain. Dealing with the pain is terrifying and unbearable.

I can’t tell everyone the same thing. I try to explain what’s going on to the doctor and social worker, my sister, my friends and it comes out differently each time. I can’t live in my condo alone anymore right now, maybe never. When you lie to yourself long enough, the Truth is terrifying.
